intended_object: The inclusion functor from the full subcategory of fibrewise pretransitive fundamental-groupoid actions (functors Π₁(X) ⥤ Type that are pretransitive on each fibre) into the category of all functors Π₁(X) ⥤ Type. This is read off the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The definition is literally Mathlib's `ObjectProperty.ι`, the inclusion of the full subcategory, applied to the property `isFiberwisePretransitive X`. `PretransitiveFundamentalGroupoidAction X` is defined as that property's `FullSubcategory`, so this is exactly the inclusion functor the docstring describes. It is fully faithful because the subcategory is full. The functor is just a name for Mathlib's general construction in this setting, so its generality matches that of the subcategory it comes from.
